io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.core.storage

Class LocationManager

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.core.storage.LocationManager

  • public final class LocationManager
extends java.lang.Object
    This class is responsible for managing the data stored at a given Location. This utilizes a DatabaseManager in the background and connects to a local SQLite database.
    See Also:
    DatabaseManager, DatabaseTask

      • shutdown

        public void shutdown()
        Shut down the location manager after ensuring all pending changes are written to the DB, and the DB thread has exited. This may block the main thread for a short time, but should only be called when the plugin is being disabled.
